name: hcapp_markKennelChatRead
description: Marks a KENNEL-level chat thread as read for the calling user: upserts the (UserId, KennelId) row in HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts with the thread's current MAX(MessageSequenceCount) (0 when the thread is empty), LastReadAt and LastReadMessageId. Mirrors hcapp_markEventChatRead, but returns a bare {success} and no FCM fan-out rowset — other devices learn of the read on their next badge poll, not by silent push. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 66, @param NULL); no permission gate — any authenticated user may mark any kennel thread read for themselves.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel whose thread (EventMessage rows with KennelId set and EventId NULL) was read. NULL: errorCode 1901, errorType 2.

rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) or NULL kennelId (1901/2): the error detail alone, no envelope.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: After the TRY block: success=1 when the MERGE committed; success=0 from the CATCH block (logged to HC.ErrorLog, but no errorId or detail is returned).

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts on (KennelId, UserId, Removed = 0): UPDATE LastSequenceCount = COALESCE(MAX(MessageSequenceCount), 0), LastReadAt = GETUTCDATE(), LastReadMessageId; or INSERT (UserId, KennelId, LastSequenceCount, LastReadAt, LastReadMessageId) with id/createdAt/updatedAt from defaults (lines 66-81)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on NULL kennelId and on the CATCH path (after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.issue: CATCH returns {success:0} with no error detail
codeSmells.detail: Lines 84-90 log the failure to HC.ErrorLog but return only success=0 — no errorId, errorCode or errorType — so the app cannot show or correlate the error. hcapp_markEventChatRead returns the full detail row on the same path.

codeSmells.issue: UPDATE branch does not stamp updatedAt
codeSmells.detail: The MATCHED branch (lines 73-76) sets LastSequenceCount, LastReadAt and LastReadMessageId but not updatedAt, unlike hcapp_markEventChatRead (which sets updatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME()). A re-read leaves updatedAt at the row's creation time.

codeSmells.issue: Sequence snapshot and MERGE are not atomic
codeSmells.detail: MAX(MessageSequenceCount) and the last message id (lines 57-64) are read before BEGIN TRANSACTION (line 66); a message posted in between is counted as read. Harmless in practice — the next read catches up.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
